How to create a Claude skill: do a task once, ask Claude to save it, switch it on, then reuse it in 4 steps.

How to create a Claude skill in 4 steps. Do it once, reuse it every week.

1. Do It Once - Walk Claude through your weekly report once, step by step.
2. Ask - Ask Claude to turn that chat into a skill.
3. Enable - Turn it on under Customize, then Skills.
4. Reuse - Ask for the report and Claude follows your saved steps. Same steps every Friday.

Needs: All plans

Official docs: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512180-use-skills-in-claude
